---
name: Pattern proposal
about: Propose a new pattern backed by a real failure
labels: pattern-proposal
---

> Patterns must prevent a documented, reproducible failure class.
> Real incidents beat hypotheticals — evidence is the bar.

## Failure class

What goes wrong without this pattern?

## Real incident

Has this actually happened? Describe what occurred and the cost.

## Prevention mechanism

How does the pattern stop it? What would an agent do differently?

## Evidence

Where has this been observed? Projects, session counts, frequency.

## Domain-neutrality check

Confirm: no industry-, language-, or tool-specific assumptions.
